caption:
Your pipeline lives in one sheet. Forty rows, twelve columns, and you stopped opening it in March.

Google started rolling out Gemini in the Sheets side panel in August 2026, including canvases: click Create canvas, describe the view you want in plain English, and refine it with more prompts until it's right. No formulas, no pivot tables.

The view that actually pays you is on slide 4. Group by stage, sort by due date, highlight anything that's delivered and unpaid, highlight anything with no next action. That's your Friday twenty minutes.

Honest limits: creating and editing canvases has per-user usage limits, you need Workspace smart features on, and the rollout is staged — if the Gemini icon isn't there, you're waiting. It also can't rescue a tracker you don't keep current.

Save this for Friday. What's the one column your tracker is missing?

body.t: One row per job: client, fee, stage, invoice sent, due date, next action.
It sorts what's there. It can't invent a date you never logged.
Click the Gemini icon in the Sheets side panel, choose Create canvas, then describe the view in plain words.

slides.headline: Describe the view you want.
slides.sub: Natural language. No formulas, no pivot tables.
slides.label: COPY THIS PROMPT
slides.code:
Create a canvas from this sheet.
Group jobs by stage: quoted, live, done.
Inside each group, sort by due date.
Show client, fee, invoice sent, next step.
Highlight rows that are done and unpaid.
Highlight anything with no next step.
Keep it to one screen. No charts.

body.t: Creating and editing canvases has per-user usage limits, and the rollout is staged — no Gemini icon yet means waiting.
It's a view, not a fix for a sheet you don't update.
